question: Under a discount scheme, a dozen pair of gloves quoted at ₹200 is available at a discount of 20%. How many pairs of gloves can be bought for ₹320?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discounted selling price for 12 pairs = 80% of ₹200 = ₹160.

Since ₹320 is exactly double of ₹160, the quantity bought will also be double.

Number of pairs that can be bought = 12 × 2 = 24 pairs.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 pairs.**
